result.scope: No lib/ or migration change. In scope only via INV-4 (secret handling) and admin-API role/group grants from shell scripts.

invariants.INV-1: NOT-APPLICABLE: no tenant-scoped schema/table/migration/query touched; scripts call the admin API, whose tenant is derived server-side from the token (no tenant id supplied by the script), so cross-tenant writes are not expressible.
invariants.INV-4: PASS: QA_AUTH_TOKEN read from env only, never echoed, no set -x/xtrace, not written to files; verification hints print the literal $QA_AUTH_TOKEN. No hardcoded secrets.
invariants.INV-8: PASS: every curl/jq failure path exits 1 with stderr message; add_group_member checks status explicitly.

checks.injection: Usernames/roles are hardcoded constants in the scripts; jq uses --arg for matching; JSON bodies interpolate only constants and server-returned UUIDs. No external input flows into curl/jq.
checks.least_privilege: Personas get only TASK_WORKER plus mapped process_routing_role groups; no PLATFORM_ADMIN or other platform-role grant anywhere. Role kind fixed to process_routing_role. Exact-username lookup prevents wrong-user grant via search prefix match.
checks.tenant_scoping: Single tenant per token; scripts take no tenant parameter.
checks.default_url: QA_URL defaults to https://qa.bizdala.com (swiftroute precedent, accepted).
checks.uat_runner_md: Doc-only addition; no privilege or secret implications.

issues_non_blocking: Bearer token is passed in curl argv (visible in process list on shared hosts); same as swiftroute precedent.
QA_URL override is not forced to https; operator-controlled, acceptable.
